_README: Frozen runtime constants per docs/semaphore-translator-spec.md §4.4. Both platforms load and parse this file; values are never hardcoded in Swift/Kotlin. Changing a value here changes behavior on both platforms identically. The flat ANGLE_TOLERANCE_DEG / MIN_KEYPOINT_CONFIDENCE are geometry constants for the lens-AGNOSTIC decoder (ADR 0006) and never fork. The flat COMMIT_HOLD_MS / INTER_CHAR_GAP_MS / SMOOTHING_WINDOW are the committer's timing -- they ARE the Learn (front-camera) profile; the Interpret (rear-camera) fork overrides them under timing_profiles (ADR 0009).

_field_notes.ANGLE_TOLERANCE_DEG: max deviation from a 45-degree canonical position to accept; beyond this the arm is indeterminate
_field_notes.MIN_KEYPOINT_CONFIDENCE: below this per-keypoint visibility, the arm is indeterminate
_field_notes.COMMIT_HOLD_MS: how long a stable pose must hold (wall-clock ms) before being committed to output (ADR 0004)
_field_notes.INTER_CHAR_GAP_MS: minimum brief-REST dwell (ms) that re-arms the SAME symbol for re-commit -- the double-letter separator; a REST held >= COMMIT_HOLD_MS commits a space instead, and an indeterminate gap no longer re-arms. A distinct symbol commits on its hold alone (ADR 0005, superseding ADR 0004 Decision 3)
_field_notes.SMOOTHING_WINDOW: frames of plurality-vote smoothing (ties to the most-recent occurrence) on the predicted mode-independent pose symbol (the classify output, not the emitted character); see ADR 0004
_field_notes.timing_profiles: Per-fork committer-timing overrides (ADR 0009). The flat COMMIT_HOLD_MS/INTER_CHAR_GAP_MS/SMOOTHING_WINDOW are the implicit Learn profile (front camera, self-signing). Each named profile here is FULLY SPECIFIED (all three timing keys; never a delta) and is selected by the camera lens at the committer-construction site -- the rear-camera Interpret fork selects 'interpret'. Faster commit (400 vs 600 ms) suits faster real-world signers; #76 (6a-8) tunes against footage. Only the three timing keys may fork -- the geometry constants never do (ADR 0006: the rear lens reuses the front decode path verbatim). A missing/malformed selected profile is a fatal load error, never a silent fallback to Learn.
